description: Hard glossy kernels streaked tan and brown, a good fistful. Small woodland things hoard them, and now so do you.
lore: Hard as a knuckle. There are two ways to open one — a flat stone, or your own back teeth — and which a person reaches for tells you how long they have been here.

[[lore/the_waking|The newly woken]] protect their teeth. They will not say why, and the reason is a chair in a bright room and a mother who was firm about it. Everyone else cracks them on the molars without a thought, because a tooth here is a remembered tooth and behaves like the rest of you. The first time somebody hears their own jaw go through a shell and feels nothing whatever about it, they generally go quiet for the rest of the evening, and the fire lets them, and somebody moves the bowl within reach. Five gold the fistful. That is the cost of the fistful, and it is not the price.
gm_notes: A small private milestone every woken person passes: the evening you notice you have stopped protecting a body that no longer needs protecting. Good beat for a first-season PC.
